readout_other: TMS single- and paired-pulse (CME, SICI, SICF) in FDI and ADM; DWI tractography
direction_notes: Left CST TUS increased corticomotor excitability and SICF (largest at 50 min) relative to right CST and left M1; left M1 TUS reduced intracortical inhibition (SICI).
safety_notes: Two participants reported a mild transient heating sensation during one TUS session (24 h questionnaire); thermal simulations showed mean 0.4 C rise.

target.label: left corticospinal tract at the level of the superior internal capsule

device.model: NeuroFUS TPO with CTX-500-101 four-element annular transducer

timing.protocol_description: 5 Hz repetitive TUS, 20 ms pulses every 200 ms (400 pulses), 80 s, once per session; TMS measures at baseline and 5, 20, 35 and 50 min after sonication.

flags.reason: 18 recruited, 15 analysed; right CST session attended by only 10 of the 15; one non-analysed participant completed one TUS-TMS session.
Up to three TUS sessions (left CST, left M1, right CST); not stated as a single number and the right CST session was done by 10 participants.
Left CST and left M1 order pseudo-randomised and counterbalanced; right CST always last.
No sham; active comparison sites (contralateral CST, ipsilateral M1) used.
